content.label: I wish I’d known about this app sooner! I set reminders and calendar appointments in the native apps on my phone, and the notifications always disappear into the ether. I see them once, and then with my ADHD, I forget about it within just a few seconds. This app continues to remind me and lets me snooze it if I can’t take care of it right now. It’s such a simple feature that should be part of every app with reminders, but for some reason it just isn’t. I’ve been more productive and less stressed about forgetting things since I started using Due. I can’t recommend it enough.

Idk what I’d do without this app. It’s essential for an ADHD brain. I need to be reminded of my reminders (lol) until the task is done, or I postpone, and start the reminding process over again…repeat, repeat, repeat. Crucial feature that No Other Reminder App Does (or didn’t last time I checked). So many options and for only 4.99/yr? Brilliant. Thank you.
Love this app and service!!!

title.label: First To Do app that really works for me

content.label:
This is exactly what I needed. It’s fast to add a task and set an appropriate time - in an hour, in a day, in a week. But most importantly if the timer goes off and you can’t do it or it isn’t done you can instantly put it back in the queue.

My only very minor quibble is that it should be easier to edit text of a completed task.

title.label: Best time management app I've tried

content.label: Thanks for making the subscription for this app so affordable. I have ADHD, and this app is far more useful than any of the invariably expensive purpose-built ADHD apps I've tried.

I got frustrated with every other app that would only bug me once and require an action to get another ping about taking medication. I’m forgetful, busy, I need to be pestered to be sure I don’t miss it, and this app is the only one that does it. This app and my Apple Watch make a dream team for my medication reminders!
Keeps reminding me of what I need to be reminded of. I keep finding things to add

I’ve tried a lot of apps to help manage my chronic illnesses and medications and I’m thankful finally to have the exact solution I’ve been wanting. I tried alarms, multiple calendar apps, multiple reminder and to do list apps. I can’t believe they don’t all actually… remind you of things. This actually does remind you until you do the thing. Set a date, time, name, frequency of recurrence, exact frequency of reminders, settings very customizable. Widget is great too. I have never paid for an app before, but just get this one.
By far the best reminder app I've ever used.  The customizability and nagging/snoozing options ensure nothing is ever missed.

I purchased Due ten years ago (!!) and have been using it regularly ever since. It's a very well designed app in general but its killer feature is the "nag". It keeps reminding you of your to-do until you mark it done. Love it.

If you check off or complete a reminder on one device it does not sync with other devices until you open the app on the other device. So if you clear a reminder on your phone it will still ding every 5 minutes on your iPad until you open it on the iPad. It would be great if that could be fixed.

This is the only app I’ve ever found that is functional in the way I need it to be. Tick tick has the constant reminder option but when I tried the app it was difficult to navigate and so complicated. I love how simple and easy to use the app is and how reliable it is. I’d love to see more functionality (like routines, habit tracker, etc.) but so often apps sacrifice ease of use for multiple functions. I think my only critique is that it could use a bit of a face lift, but even that isn’t a big deal to me. It works, it’s fast, and it’s easy to use.

DUE is a great service. It is simple, works with Siri, and provides a means for setting reminders for events well into the future, not for just a calendar year. It has made my life easier because it is a simple and very useful app

Hsf

I wish hourly reminders was an option. In some key ways Apple reminders have an advantage over Due:

1. You can set a reminder to repeat every X hours. Something like that would be great. For example: set to repeat every hour between 9 am and 5 pm. 

You can’t set a time range during which repeating reminders occur on iOS, and this would be an EXCELLENT addition to Due.

Edit:
Adding that location-based reminders would be very helpful too
Can’t live, if livin’ is without you. (I sing this to this app every single day. It’s indispensable.)
I appreciate the interface and its simplicity. I hope this continues to be a core attribute. Very intuitive to use.
I have tried MANY different reminders-included Apples and this one is user friendly and does what I need-reminder of what is DUE!
Great and easy to use app, highly recommend it.  Would be a 5 star if reminders can be set hourly (I.e remind me every hour instead of just daily and higher.)
Customizable auto-snooze is the killer feature of this app. But an efficient user interface and great watch support make it even better.

title.label: Due is delightfully quick and easy!

content.label:
For years Due has served me well.  Making changes to my schedule is Fast, intuitive, Fast, Thorough, Fast, and brilliantly designed.
Did I say Fast ? 
My thanks to the author for continuous and frequent improvements.
Thanks

Overall, the app is pretty good. It could definitely use an update to the UI to make it more modern looking. Not saying that it looks bad but compared with other applications in its price range, it’s quite lacking in UI. There are also some features that I think should be better. I think that setting up the alert should be more seamless for example, when you create a new task, you’re presented with a menu to name the task and put a date for the task to be completed. If you do not do it in a particular order and click the X button in the top right of the configuration box it will automatically place the alert on your task board. In my opinion There should be a large button that says done or something along those lines. This way, the user won’t be confused about clicking the X button and accidentally placing the task on their task board and having to go back and edit it later I can provide more examples if needed. I just think the UI could use a little bit of cleanup. There should also be a category directly on the left side of the screen with the other menu items that says completed alerts or completed tasks. I find it difficult to go back and view all of my completed tasks. I like how on the iPhones reminder system you can go view the grade out task that you have completed in the past. I still use the app every day. I think it could just use some fixes and UI cleanup for the eight dollar price tag that they’re charging realistically I’d say it’s more of a five dollar app.

I use this app daily. I believe it is the BEST I’ve seen and this is over several years. 

The only suggestion I can make is a way to offer a monetary tip as a way of saying, “Good job.”
I’ve had this app for the past few years. It keeps me organized! Worth the subscription price!
I use this app multiple times a day. The watch integration and persistent reminders allow me to accomplish everything in my life. My job and my wife thank you.

title.label: Easy to use, and the date parser is brilliant!

content.label: Features I’d like to see: The ability to choose external alarm tones, or louder tones.  The ability to set more than one pre-due time such as: One Hour before. Two Hours Before. One day before. Two days before etc.

I love this app. I’ve been using the app for about a week now and the persistent reminders are great. It will not let me forget about what I have deemed necessary to due. I’ve used many different reminder, to do apps over the years and this one is by far the best for getting thing done.

If you ever forget anything, start using Due. It changed my life.

Extra kudos on adding a Shortcut action to directly start a timer!! I’ve been looking forward to that!
So fast to grab ideas snd set reminders

title.label: The only reminder app that has been successful at getting me to take meds on time!

This app is a robust and dependable enough for me to trust it with all my business. It meets all my timer and reminder needs. It synchronizes across devices using cloud storage. The developer is very active in maintaining and improving this app.
My most used app by far. Never miss anything again.

Kudos to the developer who has done a great job on this app. I’ll be using the timer functionality more than the reminders. I always seem to have a timer or 10 running and having timers synchronized across devices is the reason I purchased. I’m looking forward to always having my running timers available no matter which device happens to be nearby. I have two suggestions which would make this app perfect for me. The first would be to have the ability to create a timer on the watch app. The second would be to have the watch complication display any running timers so a quick glance at the watch face would be all that was needed. If there were more than one running timer then display the one which would run out first.

title.label: No daily Repeat Feature? Don't Force Me to Edit Review

content.label: From Smartshoppennycounter I am a mature customer who can read well, comprehend, and follow a three-step process. I don't understand your directions on how to use this app. I am already giving up. I purchased this subscription a few hours ago, but I'm ready to cackle in the next few hours. I only need an app that shows the simplicity of setting up reminders to repeat daily. Leave alone the weekly repeat. I have spent hours looking for the clarity of the app’s daily repeat feature, and then I am triggered by irrelevant videos in the help section. How can weekly and monthly repeat features be open and accessible to the weekly and monthly repeat gesture but not for the daily feature? How can you only set the time for the day’s reminder but have not made it available or set it up to repeat? Which one comes first? The day of the week? Are you guys kidding with people's time and money? I don't want to watch irrelevant, waste-of-time videos to figure out solutions for what I have paid for. Please implore you to fix this problem, and that will convince me to embrace your persuasive advertisements about efficiency and customer-friendliness. Thanks. Smartshoppennycounter

5 stars for keeping this simple and making improvements to continue keeping it simple!! 
There are so many apps available, however this app keeps the task of adding reminders simple. All to often other apps make it too complicated and I run out of steam before the task is saved!! ugh!!

I use it as a reminder of things I do every day like take medications. I also use it as a reminder for random things throughout the day. To do apps are not, in my experience, flexible or robust enough in their notification functions. I use Things for my to do list but when I need to remember to make a call at a specific time or to check back on an ongoing process before the end of the day, I use Due. The snooze function is perfect for letting me put something off a few minutes but not forget about it.

This app is amazing! It helps me keep important tasks in view so I can check several times a day to see what I may have otherwise lost sight of. With Daily Recurring Tasks, I can check each task off for today, and it will pop up for me again tomorrow. NOTE: At first I had set each task with audible alarms and snooze timing, but soon learned that drove me crazy since I use Due for so many different tasks. Now, just the time-sensitive tasks are set that way and I set mundane tasks without alarms or snooze - that way they just pop up on a list of Due items and I can quickly mark several of them done throughout the day without as many nagging reminders. I also love being able to delay the timing for tasks if I’m running behind. If you’ll take the time to understand each of the features and options I think you’ll love this app, too!

Needs calendar in app. Zero addition of this over years of owning premium. Owners do not listen to subscribers in any shape or form. Please add a calendar it makes perfect sense with this system of repeated notifications!

I’ve had this app for many years. I use it daily as a medication reminder. They continually improve this app with regular updates that add features as well as do maintenance. I really like that you can prioritize your reminders and make the most critical very persistent.
Due will do the rest and never let you miss another appointment, deadline or goal !
Only one you need! Best one on the market, and what a great price! 😉

title.label: Must set multiple reminders for same event

content.label: I just found out the app doesn’t support pre-alerts at given times. For example, if I have a concert to attend June 9 at 8pm, I would want to add that appointment a single time, and then be able to have reminders 1 week before, 2 days before, 1 day before, morning of and 2 hours before. Sounds like I would need to set 5 different reminders for that. Why not just have a single even with multiple reminders? I could set up a single reminder a week before, but then I would have to snooze if for 5 days, 1 day, 18 hours, 8 hours and 2 hours, which is way too much math. Also, it doesn’t let you snooze a certain number of minutes before the event, like 10 minutes before. Instead, you have to do math again to figure out the correct snooze interval so that it reminds you 10 mins before, and that interval might not be available. This is the problem with apps that make you pay before you can try them out.
